plan.title: Optional T&C clauses do not block vendor bid

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and keep publishing available.
Provide the required event title.
Keep the event as an eRFX Auction stage.
Configure the Auction stage.
Apply an available Auction template before adding items.
Add the required auction line item.
Complete the Auction pricing sheet.

args.goal: On the Auction stage, open Terms & Conditions, add clauses named "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave both clause modes set to None and the mandatory switch unticked, click Done, and stop on the Auction create screen showing the saved terms configuration.

steps.note: Configure the two optional clauses; no catalog domain step can add or inspect these clauses.
Add one available QA test vendor to the event.
Commit the required 30-minute schedule starting now.
Publish the configured eRFX Auction event.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the event's Auction pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify the vendor portal displays the Terms & Conditions block.
Verify the first optional clause is visible to the vendor.
Verify the second optional clause is visible to the vendor.
Submit a quote of 100 for every line without accepting any terms.
Assert that the vendor's bid submission succeeded.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Confirm the buyer sees the vendor's submitted response.
